20.title: Lab 002: Thinking orb moves to /experiments, with a 15-second reel
20.body:
## What
The Thinking orb moves from the hidden `/lab/` to a public experiment page, and gets a 15-second vertical reel.

- **`/experiments/thinking-orb/`**: a new page built on the R&D page's stylesheet. It has the reel (with poster and a download link), the "Hold one" playground with every knob and live markup output, all nine states at 64px and 20px, and a short write-up of how it works.
- **`/rd/#experiments`**: a Lab 002 entry above Lab 001 (Spatial Hero), with a live 32px orb next to the heading.
- **Redirects:** `/experiments` goes to `/rd/#experiments`, which is the URL on the reel's end card. `/lab/thinking-orb/` goes to the new page, and the old lab copy is deleted.
- **`tools/reel/`**: the reel is drawn by the real orb engine, one frame at a time. `orb-reel.html` is a frame-exact compositor (open it to preview), `sound.mjs` synthesises the score, and `render.mjs` renders the frames in headless Chromium and pipes them through ffmpeg to `reel.mp4` (1080×1920, 30fps, H.264 + AAC, 5.9MB) and `reel-poster.jpg`. `/tools/*` already returns 404 on Netlify.
- Also: the sitemap entry, a README note, and a `.gitignore` for `node_modules/` and review stills.

## Reel storyboard (15s)
1. **0–1.6s:** an orange dot blooms into the orb. Title: "Thinking orb".
2. **1.6–5.4s:** nine-state montage, one cut every 0.42s on the beat, with a counter and progress ticks.
3. **5.4–7.6s:** the last orb flies into a 3×3 grid. An orange ripple runs across it. "Nine states. One engine."
4. **7.6–10.4s:** a scripted hand holds the orb (it freezes), spins it, then flings it. The fling uses the component's own `inertiaStep` decay, and a velocity readout counts it down.
5. **10.4–12.4s:** "Tune it." The node, reach and signal sliders animate, and the ink switches to orange.
6. **12.4–15s:** the real 20px preset inside a "Sending…" button, then the end card: "Hold one." and `quietbands.com/experiments`. The last frames fold the orb back into the opening dot, so the reel loops without a visible cut.

Brand: only the supplied mark and wordmark vectors (never typeset), the black/cream ground, and orange as the only accent.

## Checks
- `npm test`: 65 passed, 0 failed.
- Headless Chromium at 390px and 1280px: no console errors and no horizontal overflow on `/experiments/thinking-orb/` or `/rd/`.
- Reel: ffprobe reports 15.000s, 1080×1920, 30fps. Audio peaks at -2.9 dB with a mean of -18.7 dB.

23.title: Remove the reel's stray sound render
23.body:
Follow-up to #20. `tools/reel/out-sound.wav` (2.6MB) was a leftover from the first reel render and got committed by mistake. `render.mjs` now writes the soundtrack to the system temp folder, so the file won't come back.

The live site isn't affected: everything under `/tools/` already returns 404 on Netlify. `npm test`: 65 passed, 0 failed.
